headline: Which S&P500 stocks are moving after the closing bell on Thursday?

headline: Jacobs declares quarterly dividend
summary: DALLAS, July 30, 2026--Jacobs has declared a quarterly cash dividend payable to shareholders in the amount of $0.36 per share of Jacobs common stock.
